title: Fried egg, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Shakshuka, Kwek-kwek, Tamagoyaki… So what truly connects people all around the world? The world’s only coin shaped like a delicious classic Unique design combining humor with masterful craftsmanship Creative addition that will stand out in any coin collection The egg – a simple symbol found in every culture, now brought to life in a surprisingly realistic form. This silver coin is a tribute to culinary journeys, everyday joys, and a touch of humor in the world of collecting. It combines playful design with precise craftsmanship to create an effect that’s hard to miss.
